headline: President Obama assigned certain duties under the 2015 trade negotiating law to other federal officials.
what_it_does: This order hands off some of the President's powers and tasks under the Bipartisan Congressional Trade Priorities and Accountability Act of 2015 to other parts of the executive branch. That law sets rules for how the President negotiates trade deals and how Congress reviews them. The title does not say which officials received which duties.

who_it_affects.how: They take on specific duties under the 2015 trade law that would otherwise be handled by the President directly.

when_it_takes_effect: Signed July 17, 2015; orders like this usually take effect when signed.
